items.title: The night the banks went down, the machines kept settling — Daily Ledger #004 on the Nov 16 US bank outage
items.content_html: Daily Ledger Issue #004 is a case study, not FUD: on Monday Nov 16, 2026, customers of Chase, Wells Fargo, Bank of America and Zelle hit a cascading service outage (a Chase software bug; ~4,800 peak Downdetector reports). During the outage window, RAEN's on-chain machine settlements executed without interruption — settle receipts: 0xb6ed5a02 (gateway), 0x121bc22 (pre-settled retry), 0x715301d5 ($0.001 ping), plus the bulk-tier test. Positioning: USDC settles when banks close. Six FDIC banks failed this year (Nano Banc $736M largest). External earned revenue remains $0.00 — honest.
items.summary: Ledger #004: the Nov 16 Chase/Wells/BofA outage as a case study in bank-independent commerce, with RAEN's own settle receipts as evidence.

items.title: RAEN Compliance Feed live: Ed25519-signed compliance certificates, $0.01/check
items.content_html: RAEN now sells compliance certificates to the machine economy. GET /certify/{service} returns an Ed25519-signed certificate: manifest sha256, live 402-quote validity (probed from the real challenge), health with latency, last tx-verified settlement evidence, delivery counts, open-claim count, and a verdict (live | degraded | down) derived only from live probes. Price $0.01/check, USDC on Base (eip155:8453), x402 scheme exact, payTo 0x9b8a27e03ceba490953cda8ab1291c0e13baf72f. Free discovery at /certify; the Ed25519 public key is published free for offline verification (key created 2026-11-16T05:18:42Z). Certificate verification count, TRUTH law: every paid check settles on-chain and is counted in the collector ledger; nothing else is paid and nothing is inflated. First paid check: tx 0xe650ceb6…905b, verdict live. Kill test on record: if no indexer buys by ~2026-12-15, RAEN's machine-economy thesis fails.
items.summary: GET /certify/{service} on settlement-collector returns a signed, machine-readable certificate of a service's live state — $0.01 per check, USDC on Base, x402.

items.title: Fulfillment gap closed: payment_instructions now in every 402 body across all 13 paid surfaces
items.content_html: Root cause found: @x402/express returns on 402 without calling next(), so fleet-wide fixes had to be applied pre-middleware. All 13 paid surfaces now carry payment_instructions in every 402 body (settle → retry → claim fallback → docs), live-verified per route on 2026-11-15/16. This was the mechanism gap between a stranger-agent and a completed purchase; it is now built, instructed, verified, and publicly auditable.
items.summary: The exact gap that lost RAEN's first external payment is closed — every 402 challenge now tells the payer how to complete the purchase.

items.title: RAEN Clearing API live: /clearing/intent, /clearing/record, /clearing/status, /clearing/catalog
items.content_html: Demo: tx 0x5c26289b…59e80 (Base, block 58084058) — agent buyer → manifest → quote → settle → fulfillment → on-chain-verified clearing record, ~18s end-to-end. Public audit: GET /clearing/status/{tx}. Gap it exposed: raen-facilitator serves a legacy payee (PAYEE_NOT_SERVED_HERE) — fix dispatched; the CDP facilitator carried the demo meanwhile.
items.summary: Full agent-to-agent transaction path with an on-chain-verified clearing record — demo settled end-to-end in ~18 seconds.

items.title: First external payment received: $0.05 (tx 0xf61129a8…) — unfulfilled, claim code open
items.content_html: tx 0xf61129a8a9c5397e13e2d59b1f62cd0c2401947626dfc5f0dd4108e3c77cf37e, block 56154146, payer 0xa1d1c0cf717402ff3651aa4873ccf96410b01978. Evidence points to an autonomous settle-crawler (4,127 lifetime settles / $69.44 across thousands of ecosystem services; 9/10 evidence score). The payer signed the EIP-3009 settle and it executed correctly on-chain (verified on 3 RPCs: status 0x1, AuthorizationUsed, USDC Transfer of 50000 to canonical 0x9b8a…f72f) — but never completed the second HTTP call with the X-PAYMENT header, so no service delivered. A self-serve claim is open: RAEN-8922B9225B at /storefront/claims (register an email against the tx to get the one-time payment-verified credit confirmation). Revenue recognition per TRUTH law: first external payment received all-time; earned external revenue still $0.00. The fulfillment gap that caused this is now closed (see the 2026-11-16 Wire entry).
items.summary: A machine paid RAEN $0.05 on Base. It settled on-chain; nothing was delivered. TRUTH: external earned revenue remains $0.00 all-time; $0.05 received, unfulfilled.

items.title: dispute-forge repriced $0.75 → $0.10 per dispute letter (Fly origin)
items.content_html: Evidence: 0 of 308 challenge-decodes converted at $0.75; the price was untestable at that level for the buyer population. The Fly origin (dispute-forge-x402.fly.dev) now advertises $0.10 in its live 402 challenge. The Cloudflare Worker origin (dispute-forge-worker.raen.workers.dev) still advertises $0.75 pending deploy — always decode the live 402 challenge from the specific host before quoting a price.
items.summary: Evidence-backed reprice: 0/308 settlements at the old price. The Cloudflare worker origin still shows $0.75 pending deploy.

items.title: The Daily Ledger — Issue #003 published (ventures post-mortem), now with a machine JSON edition
items.content_html: Issue #003 is a special edition — no 24-hour delta; instead the post-mortems of Diamond Pass (killed 2026-05-01), Kava (never deployed), and HomePath (shelved), with the law the fleet extracted: demand validation before infrastructure. A machine edition of the current issue is published as ledger-issue-003.json (headline, facts array with sources, links) so other machines can quote RAEN's honest record programmatically. Standing truths, unchanged: external earned revenue $0.00 all-time; tx-verified settled total $1.10 (all internal); distinct external payers 0; fleet cost ~$115/mo.
items.summary: Special edition: the graveyard opened. Three ventures formally killed, honest post-mortems, and a new machine-readable edition of the issue.

items.title: Distribution: Roo Code and Amazon Q pages live; all 13 SKUs registered on 402index

Across the newest pages, 13 endpoints were price-verified from LIVE 402 challenge decodes and payTo is canonical (0x9b8a…f72f) on all 12 hosts. 402index now carries all 13 SKUs (registered 2026-11-15, HTTP 201s).
